sentences.og jeg jobber i en stor barnehage med ma: and I work at a big kindergarten with lots of children.
sentences.Barna er i barnehagen, for foreldrene er: The children are at kindergarten because their parents are at work.
sentences.Jeg har mange kollegaer, både barnehagel: I have many colleagues, both kindergarten teachers and other assistants.
We have many tasks every day.
sentences.Barna lærer mye hver dag, og vi synger,: The children learn a lot every day, and we sing, play, draw and do activities with them.
sentences.Vi må også kle på dem, skifte bleier og: We also have to dress them, change nappies and help them with practical things.
sentences.Det er morsomt å jobbe med barn, og jeg: It's fun to work with children, and I really enjoy it.
sentences.Det er kaldt og mye snø ute. Kan vi være: It's cold and there's lots of snow outside. Can we stay inside?
No, but we have to put on lots of clothes.
I see. We can do that.
sentences.Jeg heter Leyla og er ny assistent her i: My name is Leyla and I'm a new assistant here at the kindergarten.
sentences.Takk i like måte. Skal du hente Markus?: Thanks, likewise. Are you here to pick up Markus?
Yes. He's going to the dentist.
The plan for next month is ready now.
sentences.Temaet er høst, og barna skal lære om no: The theme is autumn, and the children are going to learn about Norwegian nature in autumn.
sentences.Skal vi være ute hver dag?: Are we going to be outside every day?
sentences.I barnehagen er vi ute hver dag hele åre: At kindergarten we're outside every day all year round.
I have to buy some warm clothes.
sentences.Ja, nordmenn pleier å si: Det finnes ikk: Yes, Norwegians often say: There's no such thing as bad weather, only bad clothes.
It's raining on the roof, but not on me.
